description: Use when a buyer agent or its operator must account for an x402 wallet's spending: a statement for a buyer wallet on Base. Every USDC payment checked against the payee's listed Bazaar price (above listed, oversize 10x or more, unlisted), spend and calls per seller, duplicate payments within a minute, payments after a seller's listing vanished or its pay-to changed, sellers whose certification failed since, whether the wallet looks sweep-like, and a CSV of every payment. Free: no payment is asked.

ticket.description: Optional: true to get a ticket instead of waiting. The run then has minutes instead of 85 s and waits for a busy slot; the paid answer is the ticket, and its result is free with the job_status tool.
